overall.assessment: Podcast pokazuje snažnu predanost evangelizaciji u digitalnom prostoru, koristeći suvremene alate za prenošenje vječnih istina vjere mladima. Teološki je usklađen s pozivom na 'novu evangelizaciju' i svjedočenje u svijetu, naglašavajući važnost osobnog susreta s Bogom nasuprot sekularizmu. Iako se dotiče osjetljivih društvenih tema, zadržava fokus na dostojanstvu osobe i kršćanskom moralu, potičući na odgovornost i autentičnost u javnom djelovanju.
seeds_of_logos: Prepoznavanje digitalnog prostora kao misijskog polja (nova evangelizacija)
Naglasak na važnosti osobnog iskustva živog Boga za otpor sekularizmu
Obrana kršćanske antropologije u pitanjima braka, obitelji i dostojanstva života
Poziv na autentično svjedočenje vjere u javnom životu bez kompromisa s relativizmom
concerns: Potreba za oprezom da se u obrani vjere od sekularizma ne upadne u isključivost ili politizaciju koja bi mogla zasjeniti univerzalnost evanđeoske poruke
Izazov održavanja ravnoteže između jasnog nauka i pastoralne blizine prema onima koji su udaljeni od Crkve
overall.theological_context: Podcast se oslanja na načela iznesena u 'Evangelii Gaudium' o misijskom izlasku Crkve i 'Gaudium et Spes' o ulozi kršćana u suvremenom svijetu. Također, teme braka i obitelji odražavaju nauk iz 'Amoris Laetitia', dok se pristup pastoralnoj odgovornosti i zaštiti dostojanstva osobe temelji na dokumentima poput 'Vos estis lux mundi'.

score_breakdown.theme_en: Response to criticisms of the Church, personal calling and dealing with a public role

sections.subtitle: Don Tomo: Svećenik na Mrežnici – Evangelizacija u Digitalnom Dobu
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomislav Lukać (Don Tomo) sjedi nasuprot voditeljice Arijane u studiju, spreman za razgovor o svojoj online prisutnosti.
sections.content: U uvodnom dijelu podcasta Mrežnica, voditeljica Arijana predstavlja svog gosta, don Tomislava Lukaća, poznatijeg kao don Tomu. Don Tomo je salezijanski svećenik, posvećen radu s mladima, ali je također prepoznatljiv po svojoj iznimno aktivnoj prisutnosti na društvenim mrežama. Arijana ističe njegovu „hiperaktivnost“ u digitalnom prostoru i spominje kako njegove objave često „uzburkaju duhove“, podsjećajući na ranije kontroverze, poput one s pjevačicom Severinom. Don Tomo, sa svoje strane, izražava zahvalnost na pozivu i naglašava svoju misiju da Boga donosi svugdje, pa tako i u ovaj podcast.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s crkvenim naukom o važnosti prisutnosti Crkve u digitalnom prostoru radi evangelizacije.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni dokumenti, poput poruka za Svjetski dan komunikacija, potiču svećenike da budu prisutni u digitalnom svijetu kao svjedoci Evanđelja, koristeći nove tehnologije za dijalog i evangelizaciju.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Church teaching on the importance of the Church's presence in the digital space for evangelization.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church documents, such as messages for World Communications Day, encourage priests to be present in the digital world as witnesses of the Gospel, using new technologies for dialogue and evangelization.

sections.subtitle_en: Don Tomo: Priest on the Mrežnica – Evangelization in the Digital Age
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomislav Lukać (Don Tomo) sits opposite the host Arijana in the studio, ready for a conversation about his online presence.
sections.content_en: In the introductory part of the podcast Mrežnica, the host Arijana presents her guest, don Tomislav Lukać, better known as don Tomo. Don Tomo is a Salesian priest, dedicated to working with youth, but is also recognizable by his extremely active presence on social networks. Arijana highlights his "hyperactivity" in the digital space and mentions how his posts often "stir up spirits", recalling earlier controversies, like the one with the singer Severina. Don Tomo, for his part, expresses gratitude for the invitation and emphasizes his mission to bring God everywhere, and thus also into this podcast.

sections.subtitle: Božji Poziv i Plodovi: Zašto je Svećenik na Društvenim Mrežama?
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo gestikulira dok objašnjava svoju motivaciju za online prisutnost, naglašavajući duhovni poziv.
sections.content: Don Tomo objašnjava svoju motivaciju za prisutnost na društvenim mrežama, ističući da nikada nije osjećao potrebu opravdavati se zbog toga. Smatra da ga Bog na to poziva i osjeća da je njegova dužnost donositi Boga djeci i mladima upravo tamo gdje su oni najprisutniji – na društvenim mrežama. Vodi se Isusovom izrekom 'po plodovima ćete ih prepoznati', sugerirajući da rezultati njegove online evangelizacije govore sami za sebe. Do sada je objavio preko 150 različitih videozapisa na razne teme, s ciljem širenja vjere i duhovnih poruka.

magisterium.assessment: Motivacija za evangelizaciju putem društvenih mreža temelji se na autentičnom pozivu i brizi za spasenje duša, što je u skladu s poslanjem Crkve.
magisterium.enrichment: Isusov poziv na evangelizaciju 'svih naroda' (Mt 28,19) i prepoznavanje po plodovima (Mt 7,16) temeljni su biblijski principi koji opravdavaju korištenje svih dostupnih sredstava za širenje Radosne vijesti.
magisterium.assessment_en: Motivation for evangelization through social networks is based on an authentic call and care for the salvation of souls, which is in accordance with the mission of the Church.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Jesus' call to the evangelization of 'all nations' (Mt 28:19) and recognition by fruits (Mt 7:16) are fundamental biblical principles which justify the use of all available means for spreading the Good News.

sections.subtitle_en: God's Call and Fruits: Why is a Priest on Social Networks?
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo gesticulates while explaining his motivation for online presence, emphasizing a spiritual vocation.
sections.content_en: Don Tomo explains his motivation for presence on social networks, emphasizing that he has never felt the need to justify himself because of that. He considers that God is calling him to this and feels that it is his duty to bring God to children and young people precisely there where they are most present – on social networks. He is guided by Jesus' saying 'by fruits you will recognize them', suggesting that the results of his online evangelization speak for themselves. Until now he has published over 150 different videos on various topics, with the aim of spreading faith and spiritual messages.

sections.subtitle: Neočekivani Početak: Krizmanici kao Inicijatori Online Misije
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo se smiješi prisjećajući se kako su ga krizmanici nagovorili na aktivnost na društvenim mrežama.
sections.content:
Iako je don Tomo danas prepoznatljiv po svojoj online aktivnosti, otkriva da je njegov angažman na društvenim mrežama započeo na nagovor krizmanika s Jaruna, gdje je služio. Ovi osmaši primijetili su njegove zanimljive i slikovite propovijedi te mu predložili da isječke objavljuje na TikToku i Instagramu kako bi dopro do svojih vršnjaka koji ne idu u crkvu. Don Tomo je isprva bio skeptičan, smatrajući TikTok platformom za plesove i 'gluposti', a sebe introvertom koji ne voli kamere. Unatoč početnom odbijanju, poticaji su stizali i od njegovog provincijala, koji ga je ohrabrivao da koristi aplikacije poput 'Nove Eve'.

Ključni trenutak dogodio se prije Uskrsa, kada su ga krizmanici ponovno nagovarali. Uz podršku animatorica Ivane i Megi, otvorio je profil i počeo objašnjavati mladima značenje Velikog četvrtka, Velikog petka, Velike subote i Uskrsa. Njegovi prvi videozapisi doživjeli su neočekivan uspjeh, proširivši se cijelom Hrvatskom i privukavši pažnju mladih. Iako je u dva navrata razmišljao o odustajanju, osjećao je da ga Bog poziva da nastavi, vodeći se biblijskom porukom da 'dobri pastir neće napustiti svoje stado'.

magisterium.assessment: Inicijativa mladih za evangelizaciju putem društvenih mreža pokazuje plodonosnu suradnju između pastira i vjernika laika u poslanju Crkve.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva prepoznaje važnost 'digitalnog kontinenta' kao prostora gdje mladi provode vrijeme, te potiče kreativne pristupe kako bi se Evanđelje učinilo dostupnim i razumljivim suvremenom čovjeku.
magisterium.assessment_en: The youth initiative for evangelization through social networks shows fruitful cooperation between pastors and lay faithful in the mission of the Church.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church recognizes the importance of the 'digital continent' as a space where young people spend time, and encourages creative approaches in order to make the Gospel accessible and understandable to modern man.

sections.subtitle_en: An Unexpected Beginning: Confirmation Candidates as Initiators of the Online Mission
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo smiles, remembering how the confirmands persuaded him to activity on social networks.
sections.content_en:
Although don Tomo is recognizable today for his online activity, he reveals that his engagement on social networks began at the persuasion of confirmation candidates from Jarun, where he served. These eighth-graders noticed his interesting and vivid homilies and suggested that he publish clips on TikTok and Instagram in order to reach their peers who do not go to church. Don Tomo was initially skeptical, considering TikTok a platform for dances and 'nonsense', and himself an introvert who does not like cameras. Despite the initial refusal, encouragements also came from his provincial, who encouraged him to use applications like 'Nova Eva'.

A key moment occurred before Easter, when the confirmation candidates persuaded him again. With the support of animators Ivana and Megi, he opened a profile and began explaining to the youth the meaning of Holy Thursday, Good Friday, Holy Saturday, and Easter. His first videos experienced unexpected success, spreading throughout the whole of Hrvatska and attracting the attention of the youth. Although he thought about giving up on two occasions, he felt that God was calling him to continue, guided by the biblical message that 'the good shepherd will not abandon his flock'.

sections.subtitle: Transformacija Percepcije: Kako Online Vjera Mijenja Živote Mladih
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo s ozbiljnim izrazom lica govori o razbijanju krivih slika o Crkvi i Bogu među mladima.
sections.content:
Don Tomo ističe da ga na društvenim mrežama prate deseci tisuća ljudi, a posebno mnogo djece i mladih, koji mu potvrđuju korisnost njegovih objava. Njegov primarni cilj je razbiti pogrešne predodžbe koje mladi imaju o Crkvi, svećenicima i Bogu, često ih doživljavajući kao daleke i stroge. Iako videozapisi sami po sebi ne mijenjaju živote, don Tomo vjeruje da mogu potaknuti mlade na korake koji će im promijeniti život.

Među brojnim plodovima online evangelizacije, don Tomo navodi slučajeve mladih koji su se ponovno približili vjeri, počeli moliti, pa čak i pristupili ispovijedi nakon dugogodišnje apstinencije. Spominje i konkretne primjere, poput djevojke koja se ispovjedila nakon šest godina, potaknuta njegovim videom. Također, mladi mu se obraćaju za savjete o delikatnim temama, poput mješovitih brakova. Posebno dirljiv rezultat je šest krštenja mladih koji su se, zahvaljujući njegovim videima, vratili vjeri i odlučili primiti sakrament, unatoč tome što im roditelji nisu bili vjernici. Don Tomo se vidi kao Božje sredstvo za dosezanje mladih tamo gdje jesu, jer, kako kaže, 'pastir je pozvan biti tamo gdje je njegovo stado'.

magisterium.assessment: Fokus na razbijanje predrasuda o Crkvi i poticanje prvog koraka prema vjeri u potpunosti je u skladu s pastoralnim nastojanjima Crkve.
magisterium.enrichment: Digitalni mediji služe kao 'predvorje' za susret s Kristom; iako sami po sebi ne zamjenjuju sakramentalni život, oni su učinkovito sredstvo za otvaranje srca prema Bogu i zajednici vjernika.
magisterium.assessment_en: The focus on breaking prejudices about the Church and encouraging the first step towards faith is fully in line with the pastoral efforts of the Church.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Digital media serve as a 'vestibule' for an encounter with Christ; although in themselves they do not replace sacramental life, they are an effective means for opening the heart towards God and the community of believers.

sections.subtitle_en: Transformation of Perception: How Online Faith Changes the Lives of Young People
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo with a serious expression on his face speaks about shattering false images of the Church and God among the youth.
sections.content_en:
Don Tomo points out that tens of thousands of people follow him on social networks, and especially many children and young people, who confirm to him the usefulness of his posts. His primary goal is to break the misconceptions that young people have about the Church, priests, and God, often perceiving them as distant and strict. Although videos in themselves do not change lives, don Tomo believes that they can encourage young people to take steps that will change their lives.

Among the numerous fruits of online evangelization, don Tomo cites cases of young people who have drawn closer to the faith again, started to pray, and even approached confession after years of abstinence. He also mentions concrete examples, like a girl who went to confession after six years, prompted by his video. Also, young people turn to him for advice on delicate topics, like mixed marriages. A particularly touching result is six baptisms of young people who, thanks to his videos, returned to the faith and decided to receive the sacrament, despite the fact that their parents were not believers. Don Tomo sees himself as God's instrument for reaching young people where they are, because, as he says, 'the shepherd is called to be where his flock is'.

sections.subtitle: Mješoviti Brakovi: Izazovi i Duhovni Savjeti za Katolike i Muslimane
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava složenost mješovitih brakova, naglašavajući duhovne razlike.
sections.content:
Na pitanje voditeljice Arijane o savjetima za mlade u mješovitim brakovima, posebno između katolika i muslimana, don Tomo objašnjava da je o toj temi snimio i video. Ističe da Crkva dopušta takozvane mješovite brakove, ali suočava mlade s istinom o komplikacijama koje oni donose. Iako musliman može biti dobar čovjek, don Tomo naglašava da mu nedostaje ključna komponenta katoličke vjere – Isus Krist kao središte braka. U katoličkom braku, supružnici se obvezuju ljubiti jedno drugo poput Isusa, što u islamskoj tradiciji nedostaje.

Don Tomo upozorava na praktične poteškoće, poput odgoja djece u vjeri, gdje jedan roditelj često ostaje sam, te različitih blagdana. Crkva dopušta mješoviti brak pod uvjetom da druga strana pristane na odgoj djece u katoličkoj vjeri, što je muslimanima često teško prihvatiti. Savjetuje mladima da ne vjeruju u mitove o srodnim dušama i da ne misle da je 'smak svijeta' ako ne budu s muslimanom, već da se hrabro drže svojih prioriteta i vjere, jer Bog ima plan za njih. Spominje i primjere mladih koji su se u Njemačkoj upoznali s muslimanima i suočili se s ovim problemima.

magisterium.assessment: Usklađeno s crkvenim naukom o mješovitim brakovima, uz ispravno prepoznavanje duhovnih izazova.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva dopušta mješovite brakove uz dozvolu ordinarija, ali naglašava važnost duhovne pomoći supružnicima i odgoja djece u katoličkoj vjeri (Zakonik kanonskog prava, kan. 1128). Različitost vjere može predstavljati izazov za jedinstvo obiteljskog života, stoga je pastoralna skrb ključna.
magisterium.assessment_en: Aligned with church teaching on mixed marriages, with correct recognition of spiritual challenges.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church permits mixed marriages with the permission of the ordinary, but emphasizes the importance of spiritual help to the spouses and the upbringing of children in the Catholic faith (Code of Canon Law, can. 1128). Difference of faith can represent a challenge for the unity of family life, therefore pastoral care is crucial.

sections.subtitle_en: Mixed Marriages: Challenges and Spiritual Advice for Catholics and Muslims
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains the complexity of mixed marriages, emphasizing spiritual differences.
sections.content_en:
To the question of the host Arijana about advice for young people in mixed marriages, especially between Catholics and Muslims, don Tomo explains that he also recorded a video on that topic. He points out that the Church allows so-called mixed marriages, but confronts young people with the truth about the complications they bring. Although a Muslim can be a good person, don Tomo emphasizes that he lacks the key component of the Catholic faith – Jesus Christ as the center of the marriage. In a Catholic marriage, the spouses commit to loving each other like Jesus, which is lacking in the Islamic tradition.

Don Tomo warns of practical difficulties, such as raising children in the faith, where one parent often remains alone, and different holidays. The Church allows a mixed marriage under the condition that the other party agrees to the raising of children in the Catholic faith, which is often difficult for Muslims to accept. He advises young people not to believe in myths about soulmates and not to think that it is the 'end of the world' if they are not with a Muslim, but to courageously hold on to their priorities and faith, because God has a plan for them. He also mentions examples of young people who met Muslims in Germany and faced these problems.

sections.subtitle: Istina Usprkos Kritici: Svećenikove Delikatne Teme i Isusov Primjer
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo govori o suočavanju s kritikama, držeći se Isusovog primjera.
sections.content: Don Tomo priznaje da se često susreće s kritikama zbog delikatnih tema koje obrađuje. Naglašava da mu nije cilj baviti se kontroverznim pitanjima, već bi radije tumačio evanđelje i govorio o lijepim stvarima. Međutim, mladi mu dolaze s takvim pitanjima, a u društvu se događaju stvari koje zahtijevaju njegovu reakciju. Osjeća se pozvanim govoriti istinu, čak i ako to znači suočavanje s progonom, baš kao što je Isus bio proganjan zbog istine. Ističe važnost osuđivanja grijeha, a ne čovjeka, te potrebu da mladi čuju istinu, jer je možda neće čuti nigdje drugdje. Unatoč brojnim ružnim komentarima, don Tomo pronalazi snagu u Isusovom primjeru, koji je također bio proganjan zbog svojih riječi.

magisterium.assessment: Usklađeno s pozivom na navještaj istine, čak i kada je to nepopularno.
magisterium.enrichment: Svećenik je pozvan naviještati evanđelje i moralni nauk Crkve, što ponekad uključuje suočavanje s teškim društvenim pitanjima. Isusov primjer pokazuje da istina često izaziva otpor, ali ostaje temelj vjernosti Bogu.
magisterium.assessment_en: Aligned with the call to the proclamation of truth, even when it is unpopular.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The priest is called to proclaim the gospel and the moral teaching of the Church, which sometimes includes confronting difficult social issues. Jesus' example shows that the truth often provokes resistance, but remains the foundation of faithfulness to God.

sections.subtitle_en: Truth Despite Criticism: The Priest's Delicate Topics and Jesus' Example
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo speaks about facing criticism, holding to Jesus' example.
sections.content_en: Don Tomo admits that he often encounters criticism because of the delicate topics he addresses. He emphasizes that his goal is not to deal with controversial issues, but he would rather interpret the Gospel and speak about beautiful things. However, young people come to him with such questions, and things are happening in society that require his reaction. He feels called to speak the truth, even if it means facing persecution, just as Jesus was persecuted because of the truth. He emphasizes the importance of condemning the sin, and not the person, and the need for young people to hear the truth, because they might not hear it anywhere else. Despite numerous ugly comments, Don Tomo finds strength in Jesus' example, who was also persecuted because of his words.

sections.subtitle: Crne Teme Mladih: Suicid, Pobačaj i Iskrivljena Seksualnost
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo s ozbiljnošću raspravlja o problemima mladih poput suicida i pobačaja.
sections.content: U razgovoru o problemima mladih, don Tomo potvrđuje da se u svom radu susreće s temama poput suicida, pobačaja i homoseksualnosti. Mladi mu se javljaju s izgubljenom voljom za životom, pa čak i pokušajima oduzimanja života, tražeći pomoć. Posebno ističe da je 'homoseksualac' izmišljena riječ, naglašavajući da postoje samo muško i žensko, te da se bavi osobama s homoseksualnim sklonostima. Žali što se mora baviti ovim temama, ali osjeća obvezu govoriti o njima kada se temeljne istine dovode u pitanje. Voditeljica Arijana nadopunjuje da je tema suicida kod mladih, uključujući djecu i tinejdžere, sve prisutnija, te da mnogi traže psihološku pomoć, što ukazuje na duboku izgubljenost i bezvoljnost u njihovim životima.

magisterium.assessment: Usklađeno s katoličkim naukom o dostojanstvu osobe i moralnom vrednovanju čina, uz terminološko pojašnjenje.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva uči da su homoseksualni čini 'nutarnje neuredni' (KKC 2357), dok osobe s homoseksualnim sklonostima treba prihvaćati s poštovanjem i suosjećanjem (KKC 2358). Fokus na osobu, a ne na etiketu, u skladu je s pastoralnim pristupom koji teži pomoći pojedincu.
magisterium.assessment_en: Aligned with Catholic teaching on the dignity of the person and the moral evaluation of acts, with terminological clarification.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church teaches that homosexual acts are 'intrinsically disordered' (CCC 2357), while persons with homosexual inclinations must be accepted with respect and compassion (CCC 2358). The focus on the person, and not on the label, is in accordance with a pastoral approach that aims to help the individual.

sections.subtitle_en: Dark Themes of Youth: Suicide, Abortion and Distorted Sexuality
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo discusses the problems of youth, such as suicide and abortion, with seriousness.
sections.content_en: In the conversation about the problems of young people, don Tomo confirms that in his work he encounters topics such as suicide, abortion, and homosexuality. Young people reach out to him with a lost will to live, and even attempts at taking their own lives, seeking help. He particularly points out that 'homosexual' is an invented word, emphasizing that only male and female exist, and that he deals with persons with homosexual tendencies. He regrets that he has to deal with these topics, but feels an obligation to speak about them when fundamental truths are called into question. The host Arijana adds that the topic of suicide among young people, including children and teenagers, is increasingly present, and that many seek psychological help, which points to a deep lostness and listlessness in their lives.

sections.subtitle: Potraga za Srećom na Krivim Mjestima: Uzroci Klizanja Mladih
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava kako mladi traže sreću na pogrešnim mjestima, što ih vodi u probleme.
sections.content: Don Tomo objašnjava da mladi, iako to ne znaju, zapravo traže Isusa kada traže sreću, jer samo Bog može odgovoriti na sve ljudske čežnje. Međutim, kada se osjećaju neljubljeno, beskorisno ili izrugivano, počinju tražiti kompenzaciju na krivim mjestima. To uključuje pornografiju, kocku, alkohol ili povlačenje u digitalni svijet gdje traže lajkove i osjećaj vrijednosti pod pseudonimom. Don Tomo također spominje da i svećenici mogu biti uzrok udaljavanja mladih od Crkve svojim hladnim i strogim pristupom. Grijeh, iako nudi privremeno zadovoljstvo, na kraju ostavlja prazninu, vodeći mlade u 'crnu rupu' i do misli o samoubojstvu. Ističe da je današnji svijet, vođen ekonomijom, često ravnodušan prema duševnom stanju mladih, fokusirajući se na potrošnju i skrolanje, čime im se kradu snovi i osjećaj svrhe. Don Tomo naglašava da je Bog stvorio svakog mladog čovjeka za velike stvari, uspoređujući ih s cvjetovima koji trebaju Božju ljubav da se otvore i pokažu svoj potencijal.

magisterium.assessment: Usklađeno s kršćanskom antropologijom o ljudskoj čežnji za Bogom.
magisterium.enrichment: Sveti Augustin je sažeo: 'Srce je naše nemirno dok ne počine u Tebi.' Mnogi grijesi i ovisnosti su zapravo pogrešni pokušaji ispunjenja duboke duhovne gladi koju samo Bog može utažiti.
magisterium.assessment_en: Aligned with Christian anthropology on the human longing for God.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Saint Augustine summarized: 'Our heart is restless until it rests in You.' Many sins and addictions are actually mistaken attempts to fulfill a deep spiritual hunger that only God can satisfy.

sections.subtitle_en: The Search for Happiness in the Wrong Places: Causes of the Slipping of Youth
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains how young people seek happiness in the wrong places, which leads them into problems.
sections.content_en: Don Tomo explains that young people, although they do not know it, are actually seeking Jesus when they seek happiness, because only God can answer all human longings. However, when they feel unloved, useless, or mocked, they begin to seek compensation in the wrong places. This includes pornography, gambling, alcohol, or withdrawing into the digital world where they seek likes and a sense of worth under a pseudonym. Don Tomo also mentions that priests too can be the cause of young people distancing themselves from the Church with their cold and strict approach. Sin, although it offers temporary pleasure, in the end leaves an emptiness, leading young people into a 'black hole' and to thoughts of suicide. He points out that today's world, driven by the economy, is often indifferent to the state of soul of young people, focusing on consumption and scrolling, thereby stealing their dreams and sense of purpose. Don Tomo emphasizes that God created every young person for great things, comparing them to flowers that need God's love to open up and show their potential.

sections.subtitle: Pornografija i Iskrivljena Slika Ljubavi: Poziv na Odgoj za Pravi Brak
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo s ozbiljnim izrazom lica govori o štetnosti pornografije i potrebi za odgojem o ljubavi.
sections.content:
Don Tomo se nadovezuje na problem pornografije, potvrđujući da ona 'doslovno iskrivljuje vid' i uči mlade krivom pojmu seksualnosti i ljubavi, fokusirajući se na tjelesno i iskorištavanje drugoga za vlastito zadovoljstvo. To dovodi do preranog ulaska u tjelesne odnose, gdje se veze grade na fizičkoj privlačnosti, bez psihološke i duhovne povezanosti. Don Tomo identificira dva pogrešna razloga za ulazak u veze: želju za tjelesnim zadovoljstvom (egoizam) i pritisak okoline ('svi imaju, pa moram i ja').

Smatra da je Crkva propustila priliku za adekvatan odgoj mladih za ljubav, seksualnost i brak, jer se priprema za brak u Hrvatskoj svodi na kratke tečajeve. Zalaže se za cjelovitiji pristup, poput onoga u Italiji, gdje se mladi odgajaju za brak već od srednje škole. Savjetuje mladima da prvo budu prijatelji, upoznaju se i tek onda uđu u vezu ako mogu zamisliti budućnost zajedno. Naglašava da ljubav mora biti strpljiva i da se ne smije imati 'pravo na nekoga' dok se ne kaže 'da' pred Bogom.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim moralnim naukom o čistoći i dostojanstvu braka.
magisterium.enrichment: Katekizam Katoličke Crkve (KKC 2354) jasno definira pornografiju kao tešku povredu čistoće koja objektificira osobu. Crkveni nauk naglašava da je seksualnost dar namijenjen intimnosti supružnika, a ne sredstvo za egoistično zadovoljstvo.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Catholic moral teaching on the purity and dignity of marriage.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catechism of the Catholic Church (CCC 2354) clearly defines pornography as a grave violation of chastity that objectifies the person. Church teaching emphasizes that sexuality is a gift intended for the intimacy of spouses, and not a means for selfish pleasure.

sections.subtitle_en: Pornography and the Distorted Image of Love: A Call to Education for True Marriage
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo with a serious expression on his face speaks about the harmfulness of pornography and the need for education about love.
sections.content_en:
Don Tomo builds on the problem of pornography, confirming that it 'literally distorts vision' and teaches young people a wrong concept of sexuality and love, focusing on the physical and the exploitation of another for one's own pleasure. This leads to premature entry into physical relationships, where relationships are built on physical attraction, without psychological and spiritual connection. Don Tomo identifies two wrong reasons for entering into relationships: the desire for physical pleasure (egoism) and the pressure of the environment ('everyone has, so I must too').

He considers that the Church has missed the opportunity for adequate education of young people for love, sexuality, and marriage, because preparation for marriage in Hrvatska is reduced to short courses. He advocates for a more holistic approach, like the one in Italija, where young people are educated for marriage already from high school. He advises young people to first be friends, get to know each other, and only then enter into a relationship if they can imagine a future together. He emphasizes that love must be patient and that one must not have 'a right to someone' until 'yes' is said before God.

sections.subtitle: Hrvatska Mladež: Snaga Vjere u Usporedbi sa Zapadnom Europom
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo s ponosom govori o vjeri mladih u Hrvatskoj, uspoređujući ih s mladima u Europi.
sections.content: Don Tomo, koji studira u Rimu i putuje, uspoređuje mlade u Hrvatskoj s onima u Italiji i Zapadnoj Europi. Pojašnjava da njegove česte objave s putovanja (Sveta Zemlja, Amerika) ne znače da stalno putuje, već da videozapise snima i objavljuje s vremenskim odmakom, izvlačeći duhovne poruke iz svjetovnih iskustava. Ističe da Hrvatska može biti iznimno ponosna na situaciju s mladima, jer oni aktivno žive svoju vjeru. Kao primjer navodi jubilej u Rimu, gdje su hrvatski salezijanski mladi (320 njih) svaku večer molili krunicu, što je izazvalo čuđenje kod mladih iz drugih zemalja. Također, strani studenti koji dolaze u Hrvatsku na zavjete ili svećenička ređenja iznenađeni su punim crkvama mladih na klanjanjima i bdijenjima. Don Tomo zaključuje da mladi u Hrvatskoj mole i da se svećenici trude ne spuštati ljestvicu vjere, za razliku od nekih zapadnih zemalja gdje je Crkva, prilagođavajući se vremenu, izgubila na privlačnosti.

magisterium.assessment: Procjena je usklađena s pastoralnom praksom poticanja duhovnosti, uz potreban oprez da se ne stvori 'nacionalni ekskluzivizam'.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče molitvu i klanjanje kao temelje duhovnog života (Benedikt XVI., 2010.). Iako je pohvalno isticati snagu vjere u Hrvatskoj, važno je zadržati univerzalni karakter Crkve koji nadilazi nacionalne granice (Ivan Pavao II., 2002.).
magisterium.assessment_en: The assessment is aligned with the pastoral practice of encouraging spirituality, with the necessary caution that 'national exclusivism' is not created.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages prayer and Eucharistic adoration as the foundations of spiritual life (Benedikt XVI., 2010.). Although it is commendable to emphasize the strength of faith in Hrvatska, it is important to preserve the universal character of the Church which transcends national borders (Ivan Pavao II., 2002.).

sections.subtitle_en: Croatian Youth: Strength of Faith in Comparison with Western Europe
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo speaks with pride about the faith of young people in Croatia, comparing them with young people in Europe.
sections.content_en: Don Tomo, who studies in Rim and travels, compares the youth in Hrvatska with those in Italija and Zapadna Europa. He explains that his frequent posts from travels (Sveta Zemlja, Amerika) do not mean that he travels constantly, but that he records and publishes videos with a time delay, drawing spiritual messages from worldly experiences. He emphasizes that Hrvatska can be extremely proud of the situation with the youth, because they actively live their faith. As an example, he cites the jubilee in Rim, where Croatian Salesian youth (320 of them) prayed the Rosary every evening, which caused wonder among youth from other countries. Also, foreign students who come to Hrvatska for vows or priestly ordinations are surprised by full churches of youth at Eucharistic adorations and vigils. Don Tomo concludes that the youth in Hrvatska pray and that priests try not to lower the bar of faith, unlike some Western countries where the Church, adapting to the times, has lost its appeal.

sections.subtitle: Hrvatska kao Brana Vjere: Izazovi Sekularizma i Snaga Živog Boga
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo s ozbiljnim izrazom lica upozorava na opasnosti sekularizma i važnost čvrste vjere.
sections.content:
Don Tomo naglašava da je snaga vjere u Hrvatskoj vidljiva i u broju duhovnih zvanja; salezijanci u Hrvatskoj imaju 49 bogoslova, što je više nego sve zapadnoeuropske zemlje zajedno. To pripisuje molitvi mladih, njihovom življenju vjere i težnji za svetim brakovima. Međutim, upozorava da se ne smije 'uzoholiti' i smatrati da je vjera u Hrvatskoj sigurna. Predviđa da će val sekularizma, koji je već zahvatio Ameriku i Italiju, doći i u Hrvatsku, te da je ključno ostati čvrst i ne spuštati ljestvicu vjere.

Ističe da se vjera ne smije oslanjati samo na tradiciju, već na iskustvo 'živog Boga'. Citira Benedikta XVI. koji je rekao: 'Ili ćemo biti mistici ili nećemo biti kršćani.' Don Tomo objašnjava da su Domovinski rat i komunizam, iako teški, ojačali vjeru naroda, ali da nove generacije trebaju osobno iskustvo Boga. Slaže se s voditeljicom Arijanom da Hrvatska može biti jedna od posljednjih brana duboke vjere u Europi, ali naglašava da je to i odgovornost da se ta vjera ne zadrži samo za sebe, već da se evangeliziraju i drugi narodi.

magisterium.assessment: Teološki ispravno upozorenje na opasnost sekularizma i važnost živog odnosa s Bogom.
magisterium.enrichment: Sekularizam često dovodi do gubitka smisla života i indiferentnosti prema vjeri (Papa Franjo, 2024.). Iskustvo 'živog Boga' kroz sakramente i molitvu jedini je autentičan odgovor na izazove suvremene kulture (Benedikt XVI., 2008.).
magisterium.assessment_en: Theologically correct warning about the danger of secularism and the importance of a living relationship with God.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Secularism often leads to the loss of the meaning of life and indifference towards faith (Pope Francis, 2024.). The experience of the 'living God' through sacraments and prayer is the only authentic response to the challenges of contemporary culture (Benedict XVI, 2008.).

sections.subtitle_en: Croatia as a Bulwark of Faith: Challenges of Secularism and the Power of the Living God
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo with a serious expression on his face warns of the dangers of secularism and the importance of firm faith.
sections.content_en:
Don Tomo emphasizes that the strength of faith in Croatia is visible also in the number of spiritual vocations; the Salesians in Croatia have 49 seminarians, which is more than all Western European countries combined. He attributes this to the prayer of the young, their living of the faith, and the striving for holy marriages. However, he warns that one must not 'become proud' and consider that the faith in Croatia is safe. He predicts that the wave of secularism, which has already engulfed America and Italy, will also come to Croatia, and that it is crucial to remain firm and not lower the bar of faith.

He points out that faith must not rely only on tradition, but on the experience of the 'living God'. He quotes Benedict XVI who said: 'Either we will be mystics or we will not be Christians.' Don Tomo explains that the Homeland War and communism, although difficult, strengthened the faith of the people, but that new generations need a personal experience of God. He agrees with the host Arijana that Croatia can be one of the last barriers of deep faith in Europe, but emphasizes that this is also a responsibility not to keep this faith only for oneself, but to evangelize other nations as well.

iterations.theme_en: The role of the priest on social networks, challenges of the youth and a comparison of faith in Hrvatska and Europe

iterations.theme: Odgovor na kritike Crkve, osobni poziv i nošenje s javnom ulogom

sections.subtitle: Hrvatska kao 'zadnja brana' katoličanstva: Dar i odgovornost
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava zašto je Hrvatska posebna u kontekstu katoličanstva, naglašavajući ulogu vjere u teškim vremenima.
sections.content: Voditeljica Arijana postavlja pitanje je li Hrvatska 'zadnja brana' katoličanstva u Europi. Don Tomo potvrđuje da činjenice govore u prilog toj tvrdnji, ali istovremeno upozorava na opasnost oholosti. Ističe da je hrvatski narod, posebno u teškim razdobljima poput **Domovinskog rata** i komunizma, bio ojačan vjerom i blizinom Crkve. Smatra da je to iskustvo oblikovalo generacije koje i danas drže do tradicije. Međutim, naglašava da buduće generacije neće moći živjeti samo od tradicije, već će im biti potrebno **iskustvo živoga Boga**. Don Tomo citira Benedikta XVI. koji je rekao: 'Ili ćemo biti mistici ili nećemo biti kršćani', što znači da je osobno iskustvo vjere ključno za opstanak. Izražava želju da i mladi u drugim europskim zemljama, poput Italije i Španjolske, ponovno otkriju svoje katoličke korijene i dožive živu vjeru, videći hrvatsku situaciju kao dar, ali i odgovornost za evangelizaciju.

magisterium.assessment: Povijesno i pastoralno utemeljeno, uz nužan oprez prema oholosti.
concerns: Potrebno je izbjegavati 'nacionalni mesijanizam' koji bi mogao sugerirati da je jedna nacija superiorna u vjeri.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva priznaje važnost povijesnog svjedočenja vjere u teškim vremenima, ali podsjeća da je svaka kultura ograničena i da je Crkva po svojoj naravi univerzalna (Ivan Pavao II., 2002.).
magisterium.assessment_en: Historically and pastorally grounded, with necessary caution towards pride.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church recognizes the importance of the historical witnessing of faith in difficult times, but recalls that every culture is limited and that the Church is by its nature universal (John Paul II, 2002.).
concerns_en: It is necessary to avoid 'national messianism' which could suggest that one nation is superior in faith.

sections.subtitle_en: Hrvatska as the 'last barrier' of Catholicism: Gift and responsibility
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains why Hrvatska is special in the context of Catholicism, emphasizing the role of faith in difficult times.
sections.content_en: The host Arijana asks the question whether Hrvatska is the 'last bulwark' of Catholicism in Europa. Don Tomo confirms that the facts speak in favor of that claim, but at the same time warns of the danger of pride. He points out that the Croatian people, especially in difficult periods like the **Domovinski rat** and communism, was strengthened by faith and the closeness of the Church. He considers that this experience shaped generations that even today hold to tradition. However, he emphasizes that future generations will not be able to live only from tradition, but they will need the **experience of the living God**. Don Tomo quotes Benedikt XVI who said: 'Either we will be mystics or we will not be Christians', which means that the personal experience of faith is crucial for survival. He expresses the desire that young people in other European countries as well, like Italija and Španjolska, rediscover their Catholic roots and experience a living faith, seeing the Croatian situation as a gift, but also a responsibility for evangelization.

sections.subtitle: Rada Borić i 'bolno' srce zbog mladih u crkvi: Bogatstvo vjere
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo govori o izjavi Rade Borić i objašnjava zašto je prisutnost mladih u crkvama zapravo blagoslov.
sections.content: Arijana podsjeća na izjavu saborske zastupnice **Rade Borić** koja je izrazila žaljenje zbog punih crkava mladih u Zagrebu. Don Tomo na to odgovara da mu je žao što Rada Borić u mladosti nije iskusila ljepotu katoličke vjere i pravih vrijednosti. Ističe da je, dok je bio na Jarunu, crkva uvijek bila puna mladih, što je Borić, koja živi nasuprot crkve, mogla i sama vidjeti. Don Tomo objašnjava da je hrvatska riječ 'bogat' etimološki povezana s riječju 'Bog', sugerirajući da je onaj tko ima Boga istinski bogat. Naglašava da su ti mladi ljudi, koji se odgajaju u vjeri i drže do pravih vrijednosti, budući **očevi i majke** koji će graditi snažne obitelji, a time i **zdravo hrvatsko društvo**. Spominje da je samo u jednoj godini vjenčao šest ili sedam parova koji su se upoznali u crkvi na Jarunu, što smatra dokazom da ti mladi ljudi predstavljaju temelj budućnosti Hrvatske.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je u potpunosti usklađen s katoličkim naukom o važnosti evangelizacije mladih i prenošenja vjere.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva prepoznaje važnost 'nove evangelizacije' i potrebu za kreativnim pristupima u prenošenju vjere mladima, posebno u urbanim sredinama gdje se često gubi osjećaj za kršćanske korijene. Sveto pismo potiče mlade da se sjećaju Stvoritelja u danima svoje mladosti.

citations.document_title: The Holy Bible (The New Revised Standard Version, Catholic Edition (NRSV-CE)), Ecclesiastes 12

magisterium.assessment_en: The content is fully aligned with Catholic teaching on the importance of the evangelization of youth and the transmission of faith.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church recognizes the importance of the 'new evangelization' and the need for creative approaches in transmitting the faith to young people, especially in urban environments where the sense of Christian roots is often lost. Sacred Scripture encourages young people to remember the Creator in the days of their youth.

sections.subtitle_en: Rada Borić and a 'painful' heart because of the youth in the church: Richness of faith
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo speaks about the statement of Rada Borić and explains why the presence of young people in churches is actually a blessing.
sections.content_en: Arijana recalls the statement of parliamentary representative **Rada Borić** who expressed regret over full churches of young people in Zagreb. Don Tomo responds to this that he is sorry that Rada Borić did not experience the beauty of the Catholic faith and true values in her youth. He points out that, while he was at Jarun, the church was always full of young people, which Borić, who lives opposite the church, could see for herself. Don Tomo explains that the Croatian word 'bogat' is etymologically connected with the word 'Bog', suggesting that the one who has God is truly rich. He emphasizes that these young people, who are raised in the faith and hold to true values, are future **fathers and mothers** who will build strong families, and thereby also a **healthy Croatian society**. He mentions that in just one year he married six or seven couples who met in the church at Jarun, which he considers proof that these young people represent the foundation of the future of Hrvatska.

sections.subtitle: Odgovor na kritike Crkve: Pedofilija i loši primjeri ne smiju udaljiti od Boga
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava zašto loši primjeri pojedinaca ne bi smjeli diskreditirati cijelu Crkvu.
sections.content: Arijana iznosi uobičajene kritike upućene Crkvi, poput pedofilije i optužbi da su svećenici 'biznismeni'. Don Tomo priznaje da pedofilija, nažalost, postoji i naziva je 'bolesnom' i 'nastranom' pojavom. Zalaže se za udaljavanje takvih osoba od mladih, ali naglašava da pedofilija nije problem isključivo Crkve, već se javlja u svim profesijama i društvenim slojevima. Koristi analogiju s avionskim nesrećama: mediji izvještavaju o jednom padu, ali ne o milijunima uspješnih letova. Slično tome, fokusira se na nekoliko loših primjera svećenika, ignorirajući milijune onih koji vjerno žive svoj poziv. Citira **Svetog Franju Asiškog** koji je rekao da bi primio pričest i poljubio ruke svećeniku, bez obzira na njegove grijehe, jer 'nijedan svećenik nije toliko loš da Bog neće upotrijebiti njegove ruke da Euharistija dođe do nas'. Don Tomo poručuje da loš primjer svećenika ne smije udaljiti vjernike od Crkve i Boga, navodeći primjer američkog egzorcista **Dana Rehila** koji je, unatoč tome što je bio žrtva pedofilije, oprostio i postao svećenik.

magisterium.assessment: Don Tomo ispravno prepoznaje pedofiliju kao tešku i bolesnu pojavu, te naglašava da pojedinačni grijesi ne smiju biti razlog za odbacivanje vjere.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva pedofiliju smatra teškim zločinom i grijehom koji duboko ranjava ljudsko dostojanstvo, te aktivno radi na zaštiti maloljetnika i prevenciji. Važno je razlikovati grijeh pojedinca od svetosti Crkve kao Tijela Kristova.

citations.document_title: Circular Letter to assist Episcopal Conferences in developing Guidelines for dealing with cases of sexual abuse of minors perpetrated by clerics (Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith),

citations.document_author: Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith

magisterium.assessment_en: Don Tomo correctly recognizes pedophilia as a severe and sick phenomenon, and emphasizes that individual sins must not be a reason for the rejection of faith.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church considers pedophilia a grave crime and a sin that deeply wounds human dignity, and actively works on the protection of minors and prevention. It is important to distinguish the sin of the individual from the holiness of the Church as the Body of Christ.

sections.subtitle_en: Response to criticisms of the Church: Pedophilia and bad examples must not distance from God
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains why bad examples of individuals should not discredit the whole Church.
sections.content_en: Arijana presents common criticisms directed at the Church, such as pedophilia and accusations that priests are 'businessmen'. Don Tomo admits that pedophilia, unfortunately, exists and calls it a 'sick' and 'deviant' phenomenon. He advocates for the removal of such persons from the youth, but emphasizes that pedophilia is not exclusively a problem of the Church, but occurs in all professions and social classes. He uses an analogy with plane crashes: the media reports on one crash, but not on millions of successful flights. Similarly, the focus is on a few bad examples of priests, ignoring millions of those who faithfully live their calling. He quotes **Sveti Franjo Asiški** who said that he would receive communion and kiss the hands of a priest, regardless of his sins, because 'no priest is so bad that God will not use his hands so that the Eucharist comes to us'. Don Tomo sends a message that a bad example of a priest must not distance believers from the Church and God, citing the example of the American exorcist **Dan Rehil** who, despite being a victim of pedophilia, forgave and became a priest.

sections.subtitle: Osobni poziv u svećeništvo: 'Slagalice' života i Božji put
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo slikovito objašnjava svoj put do svećeništva kroz metaforu slagalice, otkrivajući osobne detalje.
sections.content: Don Tomo objašnjava svoj poziv u svećeništvo koristeći metaforu 'slagalica'. Kaže da je život poput hrpe razbacanih dijelova, ali kada se slože, dobije se smislena slika. Njegov poziv nije bio jedno veliko iskustvo, već kombinacija Božjeg vodstva i njegove slobodne volje. Dijeli dvije ključne 'slagalice'. Prva je bila majčina priča: prije njegovog rođenja, roditelji su imali dva spontana pobačaja, a liječnici su im savjetovali da ne pokušavaju s trećim djetetom zbog visokog rizika. Oni su se ipak prepustili Božjoj volji, a majka je obećala prihvatiti dijete kakvo god da bude. Ova priča, koju mu je majka otkrila tek kada je objavio svoju odluku o svećeništvu, duboko ga je dirnula. Druga 'slagalica' odnosi se na njegov mladenački život: aktivno je igrao nogomet (čak i s **Livajom** i **Pašalićem** u mlađim kategorijama) i imao je ozbiljnu djevojku. Unatoč tome, osjećao je da mu nešto nedostaje. Njegova želja je bila raditi s mladima, ali poznavao je samo dijecezanske svećenike. Prekretnica se dogodila u srednjoj školi kada ga je prijateljica nagovorila da se ispovjedi kod **Don Mladena Delića**, salezijanca. Tada je shvatio da su salezijanci svećenici koji rade s djecom i mladima, što je bilo upravo ono što je oduvijek želio. Kasnije je otkrio da je Don Mladen bio zadužen za duhovna zvanja u regiji. Don Tomo je čak vjenčao svoju bivšu djevojku, što vidi kao potvrdu Božjeg plana za oboje. Ističe da je imao 'normalan život', ali da ga je Bog pozvao na nešto više.

magisterium.assessment: Metafora 'slagalice' života i Božjeg vodstva u potpunosti je usklađena s katoličkim razumijevanjem poziva i slobodne volje.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćanski poziv nije samo ljudski izbor, već odgovor na Božju milost koja nas vodi kroz životne okolnosti. Svaki život je dar od Boga, a Crkva snažno brani svetost života od začeća.

magisterium.assessment_en: The metaphor of the 'puzzle' of life and God's guidance is completely aligned with the Catholic understanding of vocation and free will.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Christian vocation is not only a human choice, but a response to God's grace which leads us through life's circumstances. Every life is a gift from God, and the Church strongly defends the sanctity of life from conception.

sections.subtitle_en: Personal call to the priesthood: 'Puzzles' of life and God's path
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo vividly explains his path to the priesthood through the metaphor of a puzzle, revealing personal details.
sections.content_en: Don Tomo explains his vocation to the priesthood using the metaphor of a 'puzzle'. He says that life is like a pile of scattered pieces, but when they are put together, a meaningful picture is obtained. His vocation was not one big experience, but a combination of God's guidance and his free will. He shares two key 'puzzles'. The first was his mother's story: before his birth, his parents had two miscarriages, and doctors advised them not to try for a third child due to high risk. They nevertheless surrendered themselves to God's will, and his mother promised to accept the child whatever it might be. This story, which his mother revealed to him only when he announced his decision about the priesthood, deeply moved him. The second 'puzzle' refers to his youth: he actively played football (even with **Livaja** and **Pašalić** in youth categories) and had a serious girlfriend. Despite this, he felt that he was missing something. His desire was to work with young people, but he only knew diocesan priests. The turning point occurred in high school when a friend persuaded him to go to confession with **Don Mladen Delić**, a Salesian. Then he realized that Salesians are priests who work with children and young people, which was exactly what he had always wanted. Later he discovered that Don Mladen was in charge of spiritual vocations in the region. Don Tomo even married his ex-girlfriend, which he sees as a confirmation of God's plan for both of them. He emphasizes that he had a 'normal life', but that God called him to something more.

sections.subtitle: Fenomen Thompsona i medijska manipulacija: Vjera, domovina i obitelj
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava zašto je Thompsonov fenomen pozitivan i kako mediji manipuliraju njegovim likom i djelom.
sections.content: Arijana postavlja pitanje o fenomenu **Marka Perkovića Thompsona**, spominjući kontroverze oko dronova na koncertima i kritike da 'previše kroz ružičaste naočale' gleda na mlade. Don Tomo naglašava da ni on, ni Arijana, ni Thompson nisu Bog, ali da svi mogu približiti ljude Bogu. Hvali Thompsonove pjesme koje promiču **vjeru, ljubav, domovinu i obitelj**, smatrajući ih prekrasnim vrijednostima. Ističe da Thompson živi svoju vjeru, što je vidljivo i kroz njegove osobne borbe, poput bolesti sina. Don Tomo kritizira medije zbog izvlačenja Thompsonovih riječi i stihova iz konteksta, s ciljem diskreditacije. Podsjeća da **Katekizam Katoličke Crkve** dopušta obranu domovine, a Thompsonove pjesme su braniteljima davale snagu tijekom Domovinskog rata. Naglašava da ljubav prema domovini nije u suprotnosti s vjerom, citirajući **Stepinca** i podsjećajući na Božju pomoć hrvatskom narodu. Don Tomo ističe da je i sam bio žrtva medijske manipulacije kada su njegove riječi 'nikad mrziti, uvijek opraštati' bile izvučene iz konteksta i prikazane kao poticanje na mržnju, što je slično onome što se događa Thompsonu.

magisterium.assessment: Stav je uglavnom usklađen, uz naglasak na važnost promicanja kršćanskih vrijednosti, no zahtijeva oprez u izbjegavanju idolizacije pojedinaca.
concerns: Potreban je oprez da se kulturni fenomeni ne poistovjećuju s crkvenim poslanjem.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče promicanje vrijednosti poput obitelji i domovine, ali upozorava da se poruka evanđelja ne smije svesti na sekundarne aspekte ili ideologije. Vjernici su pozvani na razlučivanje i stavljanje Krista u središte.

magisterium.assessment_en: The stance is mostly aligned, with an emphasis on the importance of promoting Christian values, but requires caution in avoiding the idolization of individuals.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages the promotion of values such as family and homeland, but warns that the message of the Gospel must not be reduced to secondary aspects or ideologies. The faithful are called to discernment and putting Christ at the center.
concerns_en: Caution is needed so that cultural phenomena are not equated with the Church's mission.

sections.subtitle_en: The Thompson phenomenon and media manipulation: Faith, homeland and family
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains why Thompson's phenomenon is positive and how the media manipulate his character and work.
sections.content_en: Arijana poses a question about the phenomenon of **Marko Perković Thompson**, mentioning controversies around drones at concerts and criticisms that he looks at the youth 'too much through rose-colored glasses'. Don Tomo emphasizes that neither he, nor Arijana, nor Thompson are God, but that everyone can bring people closer to God. He praises Thompson's songs which promote **faith, love, homeland and family**, considering them beautiful values. He points out that Thompson lives his faith, which is also visible through his personal struggles, such as his son's illness. Don Tomo criticizes the media for taking Thompson's words and lyrics out of context, with the aim of discredit. He recalls that the **Catechism of the Catholic Church** allows the defense of the homeland, and Thompson's songs gave strength to the defenders during the Domovinski rat. He emphasizes that love for the homeland is not in contradiction with faith, quoting **Stepinac** and recalling God's help to the Croatian people. Don Tomo points out that he himself was a victim of media manipulation when his words 'never hate, always forgive' were taken out of context and presented as inciting hatred, which is similar to what is happening to Thompson.

sections.subtitle: Incident sa Severinom: Medijska iskrivljavanja i poziv na istinu
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo objašnjava incident sa Severinom, razotkrivajući medijsku manipulaciju i svoj stav prema njoj.
sections.content: Arijana pita Don Tomu o incidentu s pjevačicom **Severinom**. Don Tomo izražava žaljenje što je još uvijek 'etiketiran' tim događajem, koji često zasjenjuje njegov stvarni rad. Pojašnjava da se nikada nije 'svađao' sa Severinom. Incident je nastao kada je Severina objavila screenshot tuđeg uvredljivog komentara o pobačaju, izrezavši ime autora i implicirajući da je Don Tomo autor. To je dovelo do medijskih naslova da je Don Tomo uvrijedio Severinu. Zbog zbunjenosti svojih mladih pratitelja, osjetio je potrebu objasniti situaciju. U videu je, kako kaže, 'bez ružnog tona, ali direktno i jasno' objasnio genezu događaja i pozvao Severinu na kavu, do koje nikada nije došlo. Don Tomo naglašava da nema ništa protiv Severine, vjeruje da je Bog voli jednako kao i Thompsona, te moli za nju da se 'vrati pravoj istini' u vezi s određenim temama. Ističe da je medijska manipulacija, gdje se laž izgovorena više puta pretvara u istinu, veliki problem.

magisterium.assessment: Sadržaj je usklađen s kršćanskim pozivom na istinu i razboritost u javnom djelovanju. Svećenik ispravno ukazuje na važnost integriteta u medijskom izvještavanju, što je u skladu s crkvenim naukom o odgovornosti medija.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk naglašava da mediji trebaju služiti općem dobru kroz istinu i pravdu. Također, vjernici su pozvani na razboritost u konzumaciji medijskih sadržaja kako bi se oduprli nezdravim utjecajima.
magisterium.assessment_en: The content is aligned with the Christian calling to truth and prudence in public action. The priest correctly points out the importance of integrity in media reporting, which is in accordance with the Church's teaching on the responsibility of the media.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching emphasizes that the media should serve the common good through truth and justice. Also, the faithful are called to prudence in the consumption of media content in order to resist unhealthy influences.

sections.subtitle_en: Incident with Severina: Media distortions and a call to truth
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo explains the incident with Severina, exposing media manipulation and his stance towards her.
sections.content_en: Arijana asks Don Tomo about the incident with the singer **Severina**. Don Tomo expresses regret that he is still 'labeled' by that event, which often overshadows his real work. He clarifies that he never 'quarreled' with Severina. The incident arose when Severina published a screenshot of someone else's offensive comment about abortion, cropping out the author's name and implying that Don Tomo was the author. This led to media headlines that Don Tomo insulted Severina. Due to the confusion of his young followers, he felt the need to explain the situation. In the video, as he says, 'without an ugly tone, but directly and clearly' he explained the genesis of the event and invited Severina for coffee, which never happened. Don Tomo emphasizes that he has nothing against Severina, believes that God loves her just as much as Thompson, and prays for her to 'return to the true truth' regarding certain topics. He points out that media manipulation, where a lie told multiple times turns into the truth, is a big problem.

sections.subtitle: Nošenje s popularnošću i izazovi privatnosti: Svećenik, ne 'pop tiktoker'
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo govori o izazovima popularnosti, gubitku privatnosti i medijskim etiketama, naglašavajući svoj identitet svećenika.
sections.content: Arijana pita Don Tomu kako se nosi s popularnošću, spominjući medijske naslove poput 'fatalni svećenik'. Don Tomo ističe da mu popularnost nikada nije bila cilj i da svoj uspjeh pripisuje Božjem djelu. Priznaje da se suočava s konstantnim iskušenjima da prilagodi svoj stav kako bi se svidio drugima ili da postane ohol. Ne voli da ga se naziva 'popularnim' ili 'pop tiktokerom', naglašavajući da je prije svega **svećenik**. Iako popularnost donosi prilike za evangelizaciju i povezivanje s mladima, donosi i izazove, poput gubitka privatnosti. Dijeli anegdotu o tome kako ljudi komentiraju njegov privatni život, čak i kada je s obitelji. Osvrćući se na komentare o 'fatalnom svećeniku', Don Tomo kaže da ne može pobjeći od toga tko je – mlad, fizički aktivan svećenik koji igra nogomet. Vjeruje da je tijelo 'hram **Duha Svetoga**' i da se treba brinuti o njemu, dajući primjer drugima. Nada se da će ljudi gledati dalje od njegove vanjštine i fokusirati se na Božju poruku. Priznaje da prima razne poruke, uključujući i one od osoba s homoseksualnim sklonostima, te mu je cilj pomoći im da se približe Bogu.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ispravno naglašava svećenički identitet i poniznost pred iskušenjima popularnosti. Svećenik prepoznaje da je njegova uloga služba, a ne osobna promocija, što je u skladu s duhovnim životom.
magisterium.enrichment: Svećeništvo je poziv na služenje Kristu i Crkvi, a ne na traženje svjetovne slave. Poniznost je ključna vrlina za svakog vjernika, posebno za one koji su izloženi javnosti.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage correctly emphasizes priestly identity and humility before the temptations of popularity. The priest recognizes that his role is service, and not personal promotion, which is in accordance with the spiritual life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The priesthood is a call to serve Christ and the Church, and not to seek worldly glory. Humility is a key virtue for every believer, especially for those who are exposed to the public.

sections.subtitle_en: Dealing with popularity and challenges of privacy: A priest, not a 'pop tiktoker'
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo speaks about the challenges of popularity, the loss of privacy, and media labels, emphasizing his identity as a priest.
sections.content_en: Arijana asks Don Tomo how he copes with popularity, mentioning media headlines like 'fatal priest'. Don Tomo points out that popularity was never his goal and that he attributes his success to God's work. He admits that he faces constant temptations to adjust his attitude in order to please others or to become proud. He does not like being called 'popular' or a 'pop tiktoker', emphasizing that he is, above all, a **priest**. Although popularity brings opportunities for evangelization and connecting with young people, it also brings challenges, such as a loss of privacy. He shares an anecdote about how people comment on his private life, even when he is with family. Reflecting on the comments about the 'fatal priest', Don Tomo says that he cannot escape who he is – a young, physically active priest who plays football. He believes that the body is the 'temple of the **Holy Spirit**' and that one should take care of it, giving an example to others. He hopes that people will look beyond his appearance and focus on God's message. He admits that he receives various messages, including those from persons with homosexual tendencies, and his goal is to help them draw closer to God.

sections.subtitle: Poruka za kraj: Kako osjetiti živog Boga kroz molitvu
sections.screenshot_description: Don Tomo daje savjet kako se povezati s Bogom kroz molitvu i osjetiti Njegovu prisutnost u svakodnevnom životu.
sections.content: Na kraju razgovora, Arijana traži od Don Tome poruku o tome kako osjetiti 'živog Boga' kroz molitvu. Don Tomo definira molitvu kao 'dopuštanje Bogu da ti pokaže koliko te ljubi'. Naglašava da je, kao i svaki odnos, odnos s Bogom zahtijeva vrijeme i trud. Koristi analogiju s ljubavnim parom: na početku im treba mnogo riječi, ali s vremenom se razumiju i pogledom. Molitva je intiman, ljubavni odnos s Bogom. Savjetuje da se moliti uči – moleći, baš kao što se kuhati uči kuhajući. Poručuje da će se, posvećujući vrijeme molitvi, osjetiti Božja prisutnost i vodstvo u životu, ne nužno kroz direktan glas, već kroz uslišane molitve, pravovremene poticaje i osjećaj da je Bog živ i da brine. Kroz molitvu, čitanje Evanđelja i sudjelovanje u sakramentima, Bog se otkriva kao 'dobri otac koji brine za tebe', a to je, zaključuje Don Tomo, pravo iskustvo živog Boga.

magisterium.assessment: Definicija molitve kao odnosa ljubavi i povjerenja s Bogom u potpunosti je usklađena s katoličkom duhovnošću. Analogija s odnosom ljubavi dobro ilustrira dubinu molitvenog života.
magisterium.enrichment: Molitva je 'uzdah srca' i osobni odnos s Bogom, što je temelj kršćanskog života. Ona je nužan uvjet za poslušnost Božjim zapovijedima i rast u vjeri.
magisterium.assessment_en: The definition of prayer as a relationship of love and trust with God is completely aligned with Catholic spirituality. The analogy with a relationship of love well illustrates the depth of prayer life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Prayer is a 'sigh of the heart' and a personal relationship with God, which is the foundation of Christian life. It is a necessary condition for obedience to God's commandments and growth in faith.

sections.subtitle_en: Message for the end: How to feel the living God through prayer
sections.screenshot_description_en: Don Tomo gives advice on how to connect with God through prayer and feel His presence in everyday life.
sections.content_en: At the end of the conversation, Arijana asks Don Tomo for a message about how to feel the 'living God' through prayer. Don Tomo defines prayer as 'allowing God to show you how much He loves you'. He emphasizes that, like every relationship, the relationship with God requires time and effort. He uses an analogy with a loving couple: in the beginning they need many words, but over time they understand each other even with a look. Prayer is an intimate, loving relationship with God. He advises that one learns to pray – by praying, just as one learns to cook by cooking. He conveys that, by dedicating time to prayer, God's presence and guidance will be felt in life, not necessarily through a direct voice, but through answered prayers, timely promptings, and the feeling that God is alive and that He cares. Through prayer, reading the Gospel, and participation in the sacraments, God reveals Himself as 'a good father who cares for you', and that is, Don Tomo concludes, the real experience of the living God.

sections.subtitle: Završne riječi i zahvalnost: Podcast kao platforma za prave vrijednosti
sections.screenshot_description: Arijana i Don Tomo izmjenjuju završne riječi, naglašavajući važnost podcasta u promicanju vjere i obiteljskih vrijednosti.
sections.content: Arijana zahvaljuje Don Tomi na otvorenosti i podijeljenim uvidima. Don Tomo izražava zahvalnost što je gostovao u podcastu 'Mrežnica', ističući da je to njegov prvi nastup u mediju koji nije strogo katolički. Prihvatio je poziv jer smatra da podcast 'drži do pravih vrijednosti, do vrijednosti vjere, obitelji, domovine'. Zahvaljuje Arijani i želi joj Božji blagoslov u daljnjem radu. Arijana zaključuje emisiju nadom da je razgovor bio zanimljiv i da će barem jedna poruka doprijeti do gledatelja, bez obzira na njihovu dob.

magisterium.assessment: Svećenikovo sudjelovanje u medijima koji nisu strogo katolički, ali promiču opće vrijednosti, usklađeno je s poslanjem Crkve u svijetu. Važno je da svećenik ostane vjeran svom poslanju i u takvim okruženjima.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva potiče dijalog i prisutnost u suvremenim medijima kako bi se promicale istina i vrijednosti. Evangelizacija zahtijeva izlazak izvan 'privatne sfere' kako bi se utjecalo na društveni poredak.

magisterium.assessment_en: A priest's participation in media that are not strictly Catholic, but promote general values, is aligned with the mission of the Church in the world. It is important that the priest remains faithful to his mission also in such environments.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church encourages dialogue and presence in contemporary media in order to promote truth and values. Evangelization requires going outside the 'private sphere' in order to influence the social order.

sections.subtitle_en: Concluding words and gratitude: Podcast as a platform for true values
sections.screenshot_description_en: Arijana and Don Tomo exchange closing words, emphasizing the importance of the podcast in promoting faith and family values.
sections.content_en: Arijana thanks Don Tomo for his openness and shared insights. Don Tomo expresses gratitude for guesting on the podcast 'Mrežnica', pointing out that this is his first appearance in a medium that is not strictly Catholic. He accepted the invitation because he considers that the podcast 'holds to true values, to the values of faith, family, homeland'. He thanks Arijana and wishes her God's blessing in her further work. Arijana concludes the show with the hope that the conversation was interesting and that at least one message will reach the viewers, regardless of their age.

iterations.theme_en: Response to criticisms of the Church, personal calling and dealing with a public role
